claims.text: The funding route is for requests of £100,000 and above.
An Expression of Interest form is submitted through the Grants Management Portal.
Bespoke guidance is provided within 10 working days after submitting the Expression of Interest form.
A call follows if the request is potentially suitable.
The funding is for organisations seeking funding of £1 million or more.
Core-cost major grants require the organisation’s annual income to be £1 million or above.
Project or capital major grants require the total cost of the proposed work to be at least £1 million.
The process is open year-round.

The page text only specifies financial thresholds for core costs and capital/project costs for major grants.

claims.text: Applicant organizations must be UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations, or exempt or excepted organizations.
For core-cost grants, the organization's annual income must be at least £1 million.
For capital or project costs, the proposed project or capital cost must be at least £1 million.
Applicant organizations must have audited or independently examined accounts.
The work funded must be based in the UK or UK Overseas Territories.
Organizations cannot have received a grant from the Foundation within the previous year.
